INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

2. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

4. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

6. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

7. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.

8. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills.

9. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

10. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for information – Paragraphs.

   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
